user.title: VIDAA TV found
user.description: Select the TV to add, or choose manual entry to type an address yourself.

manual.title: Add a VIDAA TV
manual.description: Enter the IP address of your Hisense/Toshiba VIDAA TV. The TV must be switched on so the connection can be tested.

data.name: Name
data.mac: MAC address (optional, enables turn on via Wake-on-LAN)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV on this port. Check the TV is on, and that Home Assistant can route to the TV's network (a firewall between subnets is the usual cause).
error.invalid_auth: The TV rejected the connection. Newer VIDAA models require PIN pairing, which this integration does not support.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
abort.invalid_auth: The TV requires PIN pairing, which this integration does not support.
abort.not_vidaa: This device does not run a VIDAA remote-control service.

publish.name: Publish raw MQTT
publish.description: Publish any message to the TV's MQTT broker.

service.name: Service
service.description: VIDAA service name. Mutually exclusive with topic.

topic.name: Topic
topic.description: Full MQTT topic. Mutually exclusive with service.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: String, or an object encoded as JSON.
